summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. files a Form 6-K announcing its wholly owned subsidiary entered into an agreement to acquire a gold stream on the Ravenswood Gold Mine in Queensland, Australia for upfront cash consideration of US$440 million. The stream gives Triple Flag rights to purchase 5.50% of payable gold, stepping down after delivery milestones, with ongoing payments at 10% to 20% of spot gold price. First delivery expected in Q3 2026. The transaction provides immediate cash flow from a large-scale, long-life operation. The board recommends the transaction. Watch for regulatory approvals and the commencement of target quarterly deliveries starting Q3 2026 through Q2 2028.
